blogPosts.title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 Finalist
blogPosts.message:
Proud to be selected as a Finalist at Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 Prelims held at JECRC University!

  • High-Impact Problem Solving: Architected and developed a full-stack solution tackling complex national problem statements under intense time constraints.
  • 24-Hour Nonstop Sprint: Collaborated with an extraordinary multidisciplinary team through relentless brainstorming, coding, and debugging.
  • Grand Stage Recognition: Honored on stage at the prestigious Valedictory Ceremony by distinguished dignitaries and judges.

The energy, collaborative drive, and pressure testing throughout the hackathon pushed our engineering capabilities to new heights!

blogPosts.alt: Victory moment at Ju Rhythm go-karting
blogPosts.title: Winning Ju Rhythm Go-Karting Championship
blogPosts.message:
Defeated 30+ participants at Jaipur's biggest college fest!

  • Tactical Racing: Saved tires for final laps
  • Precision Drifting: Nailed the decisive corner
  • Underdog Win: From 5th to 1st position

The crowd's roar at finish line was unforgettable!

The Full Race Breakdown

Ju Rhythm's track had three technical sections where most made mistakes. My strategy:

  1. Qualifying: Purposely qualified mid-field to study leaders
  2. Lap 1-2: Conservative driving to preserve kart
  3. Final Lap: Pushed to 110% capacity

The trophy now sits proudly on my shelf - first of many motorsport wins!
